education.description: Completed via the NCC Education pathway — Level 3 International Foundation Diploma, followed by Level 4 & 5 Diplomas in Computing — delivered by Daffodil International Academy, Bangladesh.
highlights: Level 3 International Foundation Diploma (NCC Education) — Distinction (71%), Feb 2018
Level 4 Diploma in Computing (NCC Education) — Merit (69%), Jan 2019
Level 5 Diploma in Computing (NCC Education) — Merit (65%), Jan 2020
BSc (Hons) Computing, First Class Honours, conferred by the University of Greenwich on 25 Feb 2021 — final-year entry (120 credits at Level 6)
